data.title: Analysis: Bitcoin Above $81,000 Faces a Major Macro Test This Week
data.description: After a sharp rebound, $Bitcoin (BTC.CC)$ is entering a more delicate stage of the rally. $Ethereum (ETH.CC)$,  $Ripple (XRP.CC)$ and $Dogecoin (DOGE.CC)$ also rebounded sharply. The question is no longer simply whether buyers are willing to return. Traders are now watching whether BTC can hold recent gains as several major macro catalysts approach, including $NVIDIA (NVDA.US)$ earnings and the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium. C...
